Explore our People, Places and Events

Northwestern Sailing Center

The on-campus center offers sailing classes, windsurfing and paddle boarding in Lake Michigan.

Alumna Greta Lee

The actor’s Northwestern years prepared her for the reality of Hollywood.

Dance Marathon

Since 1975, students have raised money for charity and danced the night away in this annual 15-hour dance party.

Block Museum of Art

Northwestern University's art museum is home to extensive collections, exhibits and a film series.

Professor Andrew Papachristos

Sociology professor Andrew Papachristos uses network science to curb gun violence.

March Through the Arch

In this tradition, incoming Northwestern students march through campus while being cheered by their families.

The Garage

The Garage is an entrepreneurial community where Northwestern students bring new ideas to life.

Student-Athletes Nigel Prince and Reese Mayer

The athletes shore up the Wildcats’ back-line defense on the soccer pitch.

Norris University Center

Our student center is home to events, dining and recreation spots like the student art studio and game room.
